From file://<CODING_WORKTREE>/.local/step07-ci-history/origin
 * [new branch]      candidate  -> origin/candidate
ARGV ["git", "-c", "protocol.version=2", "fetch", "--no-tags", "--prune", "--no-recurse-submodules", "origin", "+refs/heads/*:refs/remotes/origin/*", "+refs/tags/*:refs/tags/*"]
CWD <CODING_WORKTREE>/.local/step07-ci-history/full-history-workspace
